recognize_zh: 這是間期細胞核的螢光原位雜交（FISH），DAPI 藍色核內有 2 個分開的綠色訊號與 2 個分開的紅色訊號，沒有紅綠重疊的融合訊號；若使用 PML/RARA 雙融合探針，此為正常（無融合）訊號型態。
features: Single interphase nucleus counterstained with DAPI (blue)
Two discrete green signals and two discrete red signals
Signal pattern 2R2G, i.e. normal for a dual-color dual-fusion probe
describe_en: Interphase FISH shows a single DAPI-counterstained nucleus with two separate green and two separate red signals and no colocalized fusion signal. If a PML/RARA dual-color dual-fusion probe was used (probe identity and color assignment are not labeled), this 2R2G pattern is normal and does not demonstrate PML::RARA fusion in this cell. A single nucleus cannot represent the overall result, which requires scoring a defined number of nuclei; a negative pattern may also occur with cryptic insertions below probe resolution, so RT-PCR for PML::RARA is recommended when APL is suspected morphologically.
